title: 斜材付き自立クライミングウォール
titleEn: Freestanding climbing wall with rear braces
description: 公園や屋内運動施設の背景へ置く、自立式クライミングパネルの一式。厚みのある三段パネル、大小の不規則なオリジナルホールドと固定ボルト、周囲縁材、背面の横桟と筋交い、長い後方斜材、連結接地レールとゴム足を造形。マット・人・ロープは含まず、全体で1点です。登攀動作・荷重計算・落下保護・実用品の安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.326 × 3.135 × 1.770 m、19,920三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A freestanding climbing-panel assembly for park and indoor exercise-facility backdrops. It has three thick panels, varied irregular original holds with fixing bolts, perimeter trim, rear bearers and cross brace, long rear diagonals, connected base rails and rubber feet. Mats, people and ropes are absent; the whole wall counts as one model. Climbing behavior, load calculations, fall protection and real-equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.326 × 3.135 × 1.770 m; 19,920 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
